attchmntText: Gloster Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gloster Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 35,212.38 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 2,687.09 lakhs. For the half-year, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 64,399.56 lakhs, and profit before tax was Rs. 3,994.49 lakhs. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 18.68, and Rs. 27.91 for the half-year. The statutory auditors, Singhi and Co., issued a limited review report stating that the financial results do not contain any material misstatements. The company's net cash inflow from operating activities for the half-year was Rs. 1,621.21 lakhs.

attchmntText: Gloster Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Gloster Limited incorporated a joint venture named GUJCO Gloster Limited on 11 November 2026. The certificate of incorporation was received on 12 November 2026. The joint venture is in the jute manufacturing industry. Its objective is cost-efficient manufacturing and supply of high-quality jute gunny bags. Gloster Limited subscribed to 49,000 shares of Rs. 10 each. This amounts to a cash consideration of Rs. 4,90,000. This acquisition represents 49% of the total share capital of the joint venture. The authorized and paid-up share capital of the joint venture is Rs. 10,00,000 divided into 1,00,000 shares of Rs. 10 each. The transaction does not fall under related party transactions. No promoter or group company has any interest in the entity. The investment is a strategic move to expand business and market reach. No governmental or regulatory approvals are required. Turnover is not applicable.
